method.samples: Five alternating pairs with unchanged M7 prelude, tap sequence and assertions; one separate profiled pair; all outcomes retained.
method.measurement: Native click window capture to bubble approximates synchronous handler; afterHandler is second capture minus first bubble. Product guard begins near the end of first handler, not at capture.
method.clocks: Driver/browser timeOrigin + performance.now align epochs; cross-process decomposition is approximate. clickGap and handler use the same browser clock.
method.profiling: 1ms V8 sampling; timestamp-sorted intervals clipped to trace windows, approximate inclusive stack weights. Trace native Commit wall time vs thread CPU is separate. Nested trace/inclusive values are not additive.
method.scope: Existing Chromium touch gate only. Not a new mobile acceptance test; not a full CI pass; no proof about every host or maximum TG load.
method.orderEffect: Warm pure costs run baseline then B5 after all browser samples; microbenchmark only, not a paired end-to-end effect estimate.

pureCosts.method: Isolated Chromium page; exact archived TS bundled with esbuild; naturally captured profile beforeState; 500 warmup + 7 x 1000 calls per operation, no rendering or IO; not an end-to-end latency gate.
